subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron organization use freeform job tags, a typed purpose/display metadata contract shared with Reminders, or a narrower first-party classifier before any implementation starts?
rationale: The requested field becomes persisted cron API and UI surface, and the related metadata PR was closed specifically for needing owner-reviewed API/protocol design.

options.title: Typed classification/display metadata
options.body: Add a narrow first-party cron purpose/display contract that Reminders and future filters can share, then layer tags only if still needed.

options.title: Freeform tags
options.body: Accept user-defined tag arrays as the durable API and implement tag filtering and bulk operations directly.

options.title: Defer behind Reminders design
options.body: Keep this issue open but decide the narrower Reminders classification/display contract first, then revisit broader tags.

recommendation.title: Typed classification/display metadata
recommendation.body: Add a narrow first-party cron purpose/display contract that Reminders and future filters can share, then layer tags only if still needed.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the clearest prior maintainer signal on the related cron metadata API/protocol direction.
